states.maybe: Not sure yet: planned as not there until you confirm it.

time.normal: Time to train as at home.
time.limited: Limited time: short sessions, and every one optional — skipping one is not a miss.

trip.definition: A trip is the days you are away from your usual setup, the first and last included. For each place — gym, pool, bike, indoor trainer, running, courts — it says yes, maybe or no.

trip_maybe.definition: Not sure yet: planned as not there until you confirm it.

trip_travel.definition: A travel day: kept light — no intensity and no test — with only what the trip has, unless you leave after the morning or are back before the evening: then one session at home fits.

trip_limited.definition: Limited time: short sessions, and every one optional — skipping one is not a miss.

trip_clash.definition: A session planned on a trip day that needs something the trip doesn't have, or a hard session or a test on a travel day. Read from your plan and the watch's calendar, with no Garmin call.

trip_no_gym.definition: Away from the gym, a gym day becomes a session that needs nothing — a bodyweight session — or moves to before or after the trip.
